thread:
mia: Quick heads-up — we have a press + analyst briefing booked for Wed 7/16 10:00am PT. Need final quote and designated signer by EOD tomorrow. Embargo is Tue 7/15 4:00pm PT. cc @kevin @rachel @olivia
kevin: Ack, I can sign if legal is OK. Who owns the technical quote?
rachel: I can draft the tech quote and share here in a sec. Want it to mention latency and Dedicated capacity numbers.
olivia: I'll check spokes availability for the slot. Also need legal sign-off on the quote wording — looping in ben.
ben (legal): thanks @olivia — will take a look tomorrow morning. Please flag any regulatory phrases to avoid.
press_bot: Embargo reminder — embargo window set: 2024-07-15T16:00:00-07:00 (PT). Briefing attendees: select press + 3 analysts. Contact: mia@redwood.ai
kevin: cool. rachel, can you paste the quote draft so ben can review wording in-line?
rachel: sure — draft below:
```
“Our inference platform delivers predictable latency at scale — customers saw median gen latency reductions of 35% and sustained throughput improvements on Dedicated instances, enabling production workloads at lower unit cost.”
```
kevin: clean. Maybe shorten "sustained throughput improvements" -> "throughput gains"
ben (legal): quick note — avoid absolute claims without citation. Change "customers saw" to "some customers observed" and remove percent unless we can cite a benchmark.
rachel: updated:
```
"Our inference platform delivers predictable latency at scale — some customers observed median generation latency reductions and throughput gains on Dedicated instances, enabling production workloads at lower unit cost."
```
mia: that's better. @kevin can you confirm you can sign this exact copy by EOD tomorrow? I'll prep the embargo release once legal thumbs up is posted. :thumbsup:
kevin: yes, I can sign this copy.
olivia: spokes: @olivia (product), @rachel (applied-ml) available. PR agency rep also joining.
ben (legal): approved for embargo release language. minor nit: add "where applicable" after "lower unit cost" — ok to leave or remove?
rachel: leave it out — it's clunky in the quote. If legal prefers we can add in the body of the release instead.
ben (legal): fine. approved as-is.
mia: Perfect — final steps: 1) kevin signs tomorrow (confirmed), 2) i send embargoed release to targeted press at 4pm PT on 7/15, 3) briefing invite goes to analysts + spokes w/ dial-in. Anyone want to add a one-line supporting stat to the release body?
kevin: add a note about cost reduction approach (batching + caching) but keep non-numeric.
rachel: I'll draft a 2-sentence supporting paragraph and drop it here in the morning.
mia: thanks team. I'll post the final package here after kevin signs so everyone can reference. :rocket:
